capabilities: Sync vault notes to an aether-mcp server
Filter private notes and ignored paths before upload
Review and approve AI-proposed memories in a sidebar inbox
Run Git lattice sync for team vaults
Warm a GPU KV cache on an inference server
disambiguation: Not a personal memory or spaced-repetition tool; it feeds vault notes to an external AI memory server.
extras: Requires running the aether-mcp control plane locally or connecting to a remote team gateway; remote and loopback https endpoints need an API key. Launch video and full docs are hosted outside the README.
problem: AI agents have no access to vault knowledge, and pushing notes to a server risks sending private ones off disk.

relations.evidence: connects Obsidian Desktop to an aether-mcp control-plane server
users who run their own vLLM or SGLang server

summary: Syncs vault notes to an aether-mcp server so AI agents can use them as memory, while keeping private notes on disk.
